description: This file provides public helper functions, exports, and proxies for the ACP runtime environment used in plugins. It includes imports from other modules, re-exports of types and functions, and a proxy to aggregate testing helpers.

classes.name: __testing
classes.description: Proxy object combining testing helpers from managerTesting and registryTesting modules, used to facilitate testing without side effects during initialization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Method of __testing proxy for retrieving properties, dynamically resolves from managerTesting or registryTesting.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if properties exist in either of the testing modules.

methods.name: ownKeys
methods.description: Returns combined keys from both testing modules for iteration.

methods.name: getOwnPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Provides property descriptors for properties in the testing modules.

ctags.name: __testing
ctags.pattern: /^export const __testing = new Proxy({} as typeof managerTesting & typeof registryTesting, {$/
